title.narrative: Supporting and Enhancing Resilience of the most Vulnerable Individuals and Communities through Effective Multi-sectoral interventions in Southern Syria (SERVICE)

description.narrative: ltpgtltbrgtIn alignment with Première Urgence Internationale’s (PUI) approach to Early Recovery, the Humanitarian Response Plan (HRP) strategic objective 02, Shelter and Food Security and Agriculture (FSA) sector objectives and the Sub-objective 3 of the SHF 1st standard allocation prioritization for 2024, PUI proposes a multi-sector FSA and Shelter intervention targeting vulnerable conflict-affected populations in Dar’a (Busra Esh Sham and Hrak), and Rural Damascus (Duma).lt/pgtltpgtltbrgtThe project aims at mitigating the detrimental effect of the socio-economic crisis that is affecting the population in Governmental Syria. As a matter of fact, in 2024, food prices increased by 83% compared to 2023, while the cost of living measured by the minimum expenditure basket (MEB) nearly doubled. (WFP,2024). In the same period of time, the average income can only afford a small percentage of the MEB, exacerbating preexisting vulnerabilities and leading households to negative coping mechanism. Hence, the proposed integrated approach will combine Partially Damaged Apartments (PDAs) minor rehabilitation and an FSA intervention in order to improve communities’ resilience and promote agricultural livelihoods while reducing negative coping mechanism.lt/pgtltpgtltbrgtMore specifically, PUI will support market driven income-generating activities, by providing vocational trainings as well as appropriate agricultural inputs (CASH Grants) to ltbgt211 lt/bgthouseholds in Duma, Duma District, Rural Damascus Governorate, Busra Esham, Dar’a District, Dar’a Governorate, and Hrak, Izra' District, Dar’a Governorate. PUI will focus on a comprehensive training programs, tailored agricultural vocational training, climate-smart agricultural practices, and income-generating activities, providing necessary conditional ltbgtCASH grantslt/bgt to farmers to support them in purchasing needed seeds, fertilizers, equipment and tools. This approach is based on PUI's previous experience, assessments, field visits, community consultations, and coordination with the subnational FSA sector. the ltbgtCASH Modalitylt/bgt will also support the cost-efficiency approach and gives the beneficiaries more flexibility. lt/pgtltpgtltbrgtFurther, in order to enable protection and community cohesion, PUI will provide 50 Households (HHs) with minor repairs for their houses. This activity is also intended to reduce the economic burden for vulnerable households, while promoting and restoring their dignity. ltbrgtlt/pgt
